content: Seems that we don't have these in mathlib yet, so we can't talk about directly that Z/p^nZ is a p-group and the p-Sylow subgroup of Z/nZ (only after Multiplicative them). But I don't know if it's useful to have them; surely they will duplicate a lot of theorems. I noticed from #43061 that some theorems can't be @[to_additive] because of missing definitions.
... which means that the theorem statement can be @[to_additive] but the proof can't.
